notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.25
notes.notes: [p]Added armored kit for buses[/p][p]Added custom call signs for players and units[/p][p]Opened system settings, can adjust volume and filters[/p][p]Fixed logistics units staying idle issue[/p][p]Fixed player units receiving reinforcements in enemy FOB issue[/p][p]Optimized unit voice playback logic[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.22
notes.notes: [p]The "Repair & Modification" feature is now live![/p][p]Added a new vehicle type — Bus.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where items were erroneously duplicated during modification.[/p][p]Fixed several errors caused by casualties dying before treatment was completed.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where vehicles were teleported to inaccessible parking spots after repair.[/p][p]Fixed incorrect building rendering effects.[/p][p]Added vehicle volume compensation for hit accuracy[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.19
notes.notes: [p]Fixed an error where wounded soldiers were cloned during transport[/p][p]Fixed an issue where saving and exiting during weapon reloading caused the reload state to not end[/p][p]Added a feature where wounded soldiers dropped within the FOB area are gathered at the FOB center[/p][p]Added a feature where the front line is hidden when the camera zooms in[/p][p]Fixed some logical errors with routing enemies[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.16
notes.notes: [p]Fixed an issue where vehicles would still refresh even when the parking area was blocked[/p][p]Fixed an issue where parking point data was lost after loading[/p][p]Fixed an issue where explosion shockwaves did not damage scene decorations[/p][p]Fixed an issue where forced attack indicators failed to load properly after loading[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.15
notes.notes: [p]Fixed an error where manual commands could sometimes cause movement to stop[/p][p]Added a mechanism where higher buildings allow observation of more building information[/p][p]Fixed a crash caused by repeated interactions between vehicles[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.14
notes.notes: [p]Added armament parking points; vehicles returning to the FOB will now park here[/p][p]Added two-person transport squad[/p][p]Adjusted the composition of the medical team[/p][p]Fixed some errors causing logistics teams not to work[/p][p]Optimized pathfinding so that units returning to FOB will prioritize parking vehicles in the lot[/p][p]Fixed an error with parking point data when loading[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.11
notes.notes: [p]Fixed an issue where logistics teams repeatedly searched the same area[/p][p]Fixed an issue where unloading failed under certain conditions[/p][p]Fixed an issue where move commands caused errors under certain conditions[/p][p]Hid some enemy UI elements that should not be displayed[/p][p]Fixed display errors in some UI icons[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.08&09.09
notes.notes: [p]Fixed some causes where commands were not executed[/p][p]Fixed crash caused by incorrect vehicle evacuation[/p][p]Fixed issue where transport teams did not fully unload[/p][p]Optimized logistics transport logic[/p][p]Fixed incorrect value display in unit item inventory[/p][p]Optimized abandoned vehicle generation so they remain permanently fixed on the map[/p][p]Fixed various issues with wounded interactions[/p][p]Added prompt when warehouse is full[/p][p]Fixed incorrect hit calculation during bombardment[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.07
notes.notes: [p]Fixed an invalid repair of vehicle parts caused by floating point issues[/p][p]Fixed some issues that caused route drawing to fail[/p][p]Fixed an issue where storage entries were displayed incorrectly[/p][p]Added a feature to hide facility work teams[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.06
notes.notes: [p]Optimized the frontline advancement logic[/p][p]Fixed an issue where logistics teams could not recover airdropped supplies[/p][p]Fixed a data error caused by allowing units to embark/disembark while moving[/p][p]Fixed an issue where some tooltips would not disappear[/p][p]Fixed an issue where white noise would not play[/p][p]Fixed several medical-related issues[/p][p]Fixed an issue where victory notifications were displayed incorrectly[/p][p]Added an indicator to show suppression fire target points[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.05
notes.notes: [p]Fixed an issue where killing enemies with heavy weapons did not grant experience[/p][p]Fixed an issue where medevac data was lost after loading[/p][p]Fixed an issue where enemy FOBs would still respawn after losing all defenders[/p][p]Fixed an issue where some warnings were repeatedly displayed[/p][p]Fixed an issue where item count would display negative after picking up items[/p][p]Fixed an issue where duplicate crew members appeared inside vehicles[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.04
notes.notes: [p]Fixed a crash caused by the Encyclopedia Assistant when returning to the main menu and re-entering the game[/p][p]Fixed some text configuration errors[/p][p]Fixed an error in displaying the number of wounded[/p][p]Fixed a UI error after medical reinforcements[/p][p]Fixed an issue where some building effects were lost when loading[/p][p]Fixed an issue where unit unloading quantities were incorrect[/p][p]Fixed an issue where units could not properly replenish rations[/p][p]Fixed an issue where enemy FOBs would automatically reinforce during combat[/p][p]Fixed a save failure issue caused by casualties occurring during saving[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.03
notes.notes: [p]Added an Encyclopedia Helper that shows related encyclopedia entries for the current interaction object[/p][p]Fixed an error where saved game duration was not displayed correctly[/p][p]Fixed an error where facilities could not be constructed even when manpower was sufficient[/p][p]Fixed an error where manpower consumption was incorrect during reinforcement[/p][p]Optimized some encyclopedia text[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.02
notes.notes: [p]Fixed an error when infantry dropped items on vehicles[/p][p]Fixed an issue where units froze before pathfinding results were returned[/p][p]Added a toggle to allow or prevent logistics squads from crossing the frontline on their own[/p][p]Fixed an issue where units did not respond to orders under certain conditions[/p][p]Optimized the pathfinding logic for logistics squads when returning[/p][p]Blocked the interaction where players incorrectly connected intact vehicles to damaged ones[/p][p]Fixed some errors caused by click exploits[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.09.01
notes.notes: [p]Changed fonts and some UI styles to improve readability[/p][p]Fixed an issue where some text in the command menu could not be aligned[/p][p]Added a limit to the maximum number of collection zones to prevent crashes caused by setting too many at once[/p][p]Revised part of the tutorial content to make it smoother[/p][p]Fixed a crash caused by a pathfinding error[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.08.31
notes.notes: [p]Fixed the issue where transport teams could not unload when roads were congested.[/p][p]Added the ability to select collection areas via box selection.[/p][p]Fixed some UI display issues when creating a new FOB.[/p][p]Fixed the crash when work teams boarded vehicles.[/p][p]Fixed the error caused by repeatedly boarding vehicles.[/p][p]Fixed the issue where work teams could not add or remove members after loading a save.[/p][p]Fixed the issue where units continued to retreat even after leaving combat.[/p][p]Fixed the incorrect calculation of repair kit usage.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.08.30
notes.notes: [p]New Unit: Pickup Truck (82mm Mortar), along with the artillery adjustment mechanism. Now, when a player-controlled unit conducts bombardment, it will continuously adjust to reduce the dispersion of impact points.[/p][p]Fixed some errors during item transportation.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where some weapon barrels had excessively low durability.[/p][p]Fixed errors caused by not following the tutorial instructions.[/p][p]Fixed a crash when entering a vehicle after repair completion upon loading.[/p][p]Fixed an issue with event time calculation.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.08.29
notes.notes: [p]New Mechanic: Units with obstructed vision can roughly guess the enemy’s position based on activity traces and noises.[/p][p]Reduced the number of enemy troops in some attacks.[/p][p]Fixed an issue where the last member of an infantry squad would not die.[/p][p]Fixed a bug where linked information of vehicles being boarded was lost after loading.[/p][p]Optimized some causes of stuttering during battles.[/p][p]Fixed some errors related to enemy traces when loading.[/p][p]Changed the squad badge marker for work groups.[/p][p]Added a shortcut button to quickly create a new squad.[/p][p]Fixed an issue that could cause load errors.[/p][p]Added some new sound effects.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.08.28
notes.notes: [p]Fixed an issue where vehicles were in the wrong position after loading[/p][p]Fixed an issue where evacuated vehicles still appeared in the list[/p][p]Added a new stewed meat recipe in the canteen[/p][p]Fixed an issue where medical data was partially lost after loading[/p][p]Restricted the minimum efficiency of facility operations[/p][p]Fixed an issue where reinforcements were not replenished outside the initial base[/p][p]Fixed a text display error after enemy forces occupied buildings[/p][p]Fixed an issue where vehicle data was reset after crew disembarked[/p][p]Fixed an issue where crew could not interact after dying inside a vehicle[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - 2025.08.27

notes.notes: [p]Modified some tutorial text[/p][p]Fixed some text configuration errors[/p][p]Adjusted text background style[/p][p]Fixed some pathfinding errors[/p][p]Fixed crash issue when eating at outpost[/p][p]Fixed the crash when FOB was dismantled.[/p][p]Disabled the FOB deletion feature in the tutorial.[/p][p]Fixed the crash caused by writing off-map artillery targets to the save.[/p][p]Fixed possible camera position errors when loading.[/p][p]Limited the maximum duration of enemy artillery preparation.[/p][p]Fixed crashes when repairing vehicles.[/p][p]Adjusted weapon barrel wear values during firing.[/p][p]Fixed the issue where no parking spot was found when ordering new equipment.[/p][p]Fixed residual data not cleared after interrupting transport squad work.[/p][p]Fixed crashes caused by repeatedly switching states during transport squad work.[/p][p]Fixed navigation errors caused by unknown reasons.[/p][p][/p]
